name: Digital Earth Africa Water Observations from Space
description: Digital Earth Africa built a continental surface-water service by running the Australian WOfS classifier on Landsat reflectance imagery over Africa. Regional partners validated the service across different African landscapes. It produces water classifications for individual Landsat scenes and summaries of water occurrence over time.

links.statement: Digital Earth Africa transferred the Australian WOfS decision tree to a different continental Landsat archive and validated its performance across Africa with regional organisations.

evidence.supports: African implementation team identifies the Australian algorithm and describes the continental validation.

links.statement: Digital Earth Africa's documented production service applies the water classifier to Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance scenes and uses the associated cloud and cloud-shadow flags.
